nodes.label: Project Isolation via scopedProjectId
nodes.rationale: All data, agent state, tools, and memory are isolated by project_id. Tools no longer receive project_id as a parameter — it is injected via createStudioToolsServer(projectId) as scopedProjectId and enforced internally. This prevents cross-project access and simplifies tool signatures.

nodes.label: Agent Handoff Flow (Directed graph of allowed transitions)
nodes.rationale: Hardcoded handoff chain: game_designer→ceo, ceo→architect|biz_designer, architect→engineer, engineer→biz_designer, biz_designer→ceo. team_builder runs after each agent finishes as a memory-summarizer with empty handoffTargets. This is business-critical logic in tools.ts that must not be arbitrarily modified.
nodes.norm_label: agent handoff flow (directed graph of allowed transitions)

nodes.label: No Workaround Principle (Root-cause-first debugging)
nodes.rationale: Every fix must be based on correct root cause analysis. Never relax assertions, add fallbacks, or bypass normal flow just to make tests pass. Problems must be root-caused before fixing, not guessed. This is the cardinal rule across all engineering work.

nodes.label: project_id Architecture Principle (Schema removal + scoped injection)
nodes.rationale: Tool zod schemas have removed project_id as an input parameter. createStudioToolsServer(projectId) injects scopedProjectId at creation time. All tools use scopedProjectId internally and reject cross-project access. The enforceProject function is dead code and has been removed.
nodes.norm_label: project_id architecture principle (schema removal + scoped injection)

nodes.label: Documentation Update Checklist (10-file audit on every change)
nodes.rationale: After any significant change or new feature, all affected documentation must be proactively checked and updated: README.md, README.zh-CN.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (both langs), .agent/memory/* (ARCHITECTURE, INDEX, E2E_TESTING, CONVENTIONS, MEMORY), .agent/specs/*, and .agent/AI_AGENT_COMMON_INSTRUCTIONS.md. Unrelated docs should not be modified.
nodes.norm_label: documentation update checklist (10-file audit on every change)

nodes.label: CI Debug Cycle (SPEC-014: push→poll→download→analyze→fix loop)
nodes.rationale: After git push, the coding agent polls GitHub Actions CI status at 60s intervals. On failure, downloads job logs + allure-report artifact, analyzes root cause, fixes code, and pushes again. Exit conditions: all pass, 10 iterations exceeded, 3 consecutive identical failures, or cancelled/skipped. PAT via GITHUB_PAT env or .github-pat file.

nodes.label: data-testid Architecture (Selector stability via deterministic attributes)
nodes.rationale: E2E test selectors must use data-testid attributes rather than CSS class-based selectors (which break on DOM changes). 32 testids cover 100% of interactive elements. Naming convention: {feature-abbreviation}-{element}. Dynamic IDs use suffixes (handoff-card-${id}, proposal-item-${id}).
nodes.norm_label: data-testid architecture (selector stability via deterministic attributes)

nodes.label: Event Loop Test Architecture (Goal-state-driven non-blocking polling)
nodes.rationale: Replaces fixed waitForTimeout chains with a goal-state-driven event loop: 5 steps per iteration (permission→accept→confirm→count cards→count games), non-blocking try/catch with short timeouts, exits when cardCount>=3 && gameCount>=1. Eliminates timing fragility in CI and manual modes.
nodes.norm_label: event loop test architecture (goal-state-driven non-blocking polling)

nodes.label: Mock Queue Orchestration (per-agent FIFO queues with pre-queueing)
nodes.rationale: All mock responses are pre-queued before sending the workflow command. Mock server routes by (projectId, agentRole) via HTTP headers, with independent per-agent FIFO queues. This eliminates cross-agent interference and ensures deterministic tool-call sequencing in E2E tests.
nodes.norm_label: mock queue orchestration (per-agent fifo queues with pre-queueing)

nodes.label: MCP Tool Execution (Process-internal, not mock-server-mediated)
nodes.rationale: Mock Server only returns tool_calls in its SSE stream; actual tool execution happens inside Studio Backend via createSdkMcpServer(). Mock Server MCP endpoints (/mcp/servers, /mcp/servers/{id}/tools) are dead code — the SDK never calls them.

nodes.label: team_builder Agent Detection (Distinct from CEO)
nodes.rationale: team_builder requests are easily confused with CEO. Detection requires checking for keywords '团队建设' or 'Team Building' in systemPrompt. team_builder has empty handoffTargets and serves as a post-session memory summarizer triggered by the system.

nodes.label: Star-Office Agent State Mapping (Studio→SO-UI 3-state model)
nodes.rationale: Bidirectional state sync via HTTP: idle→休息区, working→工作区, error→Bug区. Sync service (server/star-office-sync.ts) uses /set_state and /agent-push APIs. JOIN_KEY defaults to ocj_example_team_01.

nodes.label: Build Strategy Pattern (game_type→build command mapping)
nodes.rationale: Build service reads dist/metadata.json game_type field to select strategy: h5→npm install && npm run build (PixiJS+Matter.js+Vite), phaser-mobile→npm install && npm run build && npx cap sync (Phaser 3+Capacitor+Vite). New game types require only registering a new strategy in GameEngineBuilder.

nodes.label: Test Mode Toggle Pattern (Microservice-internal fixed project_id)
nodes.rationale: BUILD_SERVICE_TEST_MODE=true causes POST /api/projects to return a fixed ID (build-proj-001) instead of UUID. Toggle lives inside the microservice only; studio backend is unaware. Same pattern as IMAGE_SERVICE_TEST_MODE, CREATOR_SERVICE_TEST_MODE, DRAWIO_SERVICE_TEST_MODE. Eliminates UUID mismatch in mock chains.
nodes.norm_label: test mode toggle pattern (microservice-internal fixed project_id)

nodes.label: Path Security Pattern (resolve_safe_path for file operations)
nodes.rationale: All file path operations in microservices use resolve_safe_path(base, user_path) which validates the resolved path stays within the trusted base directory. Rejects path traversal attacks. Applied on both Python (microservice) and TypeScript (client) sides. Direct os.path.join is forbidden.
nodes.norm_label: path security pattern (resolve_safe_path for file operations)

nodes.label: Creator Service Test Mode Toggle
nodes.rationale: CREATOR_SERVICE_TEST_MODE=true returns fixed project_id bld-proj-001. Same toggle pattern as build/image/drawio services.

nodes.label: Drawio Service Test Mode Toggle
nodes.rationale: DRAWIO_SERVICE_TEST_MODE=true returns fixed project_id drw-proj-001. Same toggle pattern as other microservices.

nodes.label: Factory Pattern (createStudioToolsServer dynamic MCP instances)
nodes.rationale: createStudioToolsServer(projectId, agentId) dynamically produces scoped MCP tool instances per session, injecting project context and role-based permissions.

nodes.label: Strategy/Plugin Pattern (LintChecker pluggable interface)
nodes.rationale: Lint Framework checkers implement LintChecker interface and register in builtInCheckers array. New rules require only interface implementation and one-line registration — no changes to the main flow.

nodes.label: Observer/Pub-Sub Pattern (AgentManager→SSEBroadcaster→StarOffice)
nodes.rationale: AgentManager emits activity events, index.ts subscribes and forwards to SSE Broadcaster and StarOffice sync. Decoupled via EventEmitter.

nodes.label: State Machine Pattern (TASK_STATUS_FLOW + handoff states)
nodes.rationale: Task board: todo→developing→testing→done with blocked branch. Handoffs: pending→accepted→confirmed. Explicit transition tables in tools.ts and index.ts prevent illegal state jumps.

nodes.label: Repository Pattern (db.ts CRUD abstraction over SQLite)
nodes.rationale: SQL operations are wrapped as domain functions (create/get/update) in server/db.ts, decoupling SQL from business logic.
nodes.norm_label: repository pattern (db.ts crud abstraction over sqlite)

nodes.label: Adapter Pattern (star-office-sync.ts protocol mapping)
nodes.rationale: star-office-sync.ts maps internal Studio agent states to external Star-Office protocol, shielding upstream model differences.

nodes.label: Template Method Pattern (runFullWorkflowTest parameterized skeleton)
nodes.rationale: runFullWorkflowTest provides a fixed test skeleton parameterized by autopilot, gameName, and testId. UI-007 and UI-008 share this skeleton, eliminating duplicate test logic.

nodes.label: Engineer Dual Task State Sync (develop+test synchronized)
nodes.rationale: The engineer agent holds both 'developing' and 'testing' task states simultaneously. System prompt enforces mandatory dual-state synchronization to prevent state drift.
nodes.norm_label: engineer dual task state sync (develop+test synchronized)

nodes.label: submit_game Build Integration (10-step flow with build service)
nodes.rationale: submit_game will be extended to: read source→tar.gz→upload to build-service→trigger build→poll status→download output→extract to games/latest/dist→continue with ZIP→Lint→SonarQube→MinIO. This integrates the build service into the existing submit pipeline.
nodes.norm_label: submit_game build integration (10-step flow with build service)

nodes.label: Permission Request System (CAN_AUTO_ALLOW tiered authorization)
nodes.rationale: Four-tiered auto-allow system: ALWAYS_ALLOW (unconditional), AUTOPILOT_ALLOW (autopilot-gated), ENGINEER_AUTOPILOT_ALLOW (engineer+autopilot), ENGINEER_ALLOW (engineer only). Tools not in CAN_AUTO_ALLOW trigger permission_request SSE events for UI approval.

nodes.label: GitHub PAT Credentials Convention
nodes.rationale: PAT is stored via environment variable or .github-pat file to avoid version control exposure, with repo scope for minimal authorization.

nodes.label: UI Test Auto Debug Loop
nodes.rationale: Automated push → poll CI → analyze logs → fix → repush cycle, capped at 10 iterations or 45 minutes, to self-heal failing UI tests.

nodes.label: GAME_URL Environment Injection
nodes.rationale: Test scripts must not hardcode run-service addresses; test-service injects GAME_URL, RUN_PROJECT_ID, and RUN_SERVICE_HOST environment variables at runtime for safe, reusable testing.

nodes.label: AI Image Generation + Python Post-processing Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Recommended art production flow: AI generate 256×256 PNG → Python/Pillow edge-detection background removal → green/cyan artifact cleanup → circular mask → place in assets. Avoids manual art creation bottleneck.
nodes.norm_label: ai image generation + python post-processing pipeline

nodes.label: Microservice Test Mode Toggle Pattern
nodes.rationale: UI test mode env var (e.g., IMAGE_SERVICE_TEST_MODE=true) sets fixed project IDs to avoid UUID mismatch in mock chains. Pattern replicated across image-service, video-service, run-service, and test-service.

nodes.label: Microservice Architectural Pattern (Creator-replica)
nodes.rationale: All new microservices (image, video, run, test, build) replicate the creator service (Blender) architecture pattern: independent FastAPI container → HTTP → TS client → MCP tools (engineer-only). This ensures consistency in project CRUD, file management, path security, test mode toggles, and Docker Compose integration.

nodes.label: Handler-Metadata Separation Pattern
nodes.rationale: Tool definitions are split into TOOL_META_DEFINITIONS (pure name/description/inputSchema) separate from handler implementations, enabling search, reuse by permission system, and single source of truth for tool metadata.

nodes.label: description Field XSS Sanitization
nodes.rationale: submit_game description must be XSS-sanitized using allowlist strategy (p, br, strong, em, ul, ol, li, code, pre, a, span, div; only a[href|title|target|rel]). Script tags, on* event attributes, and javascript:/data: URLs are blocked.

nodes.label: SSE Event Streaming
nodes.rationale: Frontend subscribes to /api/observe SSE endpoint for real-time backend event streaming; enables live agent status, proposal/task/handoff/game lifecycle updates without polling.

nodes.label: Project-Level Data Isolation
nodes.rationale: Data and observability streams isolated by project_id; MCP tool schemas no longer require project_id parameter — backend injects scoped project context at tool-server initialization and enforces isolation internally. SSE broadcaster skips emission when projectId missing to prevent cross-project event leakage.

nodes.label: Extensible Lint Framework
nodes.rationale: Pluggable checker architecture supporting HTML structure, HTTP method safety, JS security, and SonarQube quality scans; supports HTML mode and ZIP package mode. Error-level issues block submit_game; warn-level issues logged only.

nodes.label: Questionnaire-Based Proposal Submission
nodes.rationale: Structured game design questionnaire for non-technical users; renders to Markdown with source='questionnaire' tag for distinction from free-text proposals.

nodes.label: Game Artifact Management
nodes.rationale: Supports HTML content mode and packaged file mode (ZIP via MinIO); submit_game triggers dual lint check (SonarQube + game-engineering); game preview supports Sonar report download.

nodes.label: Game Dev Studio Brand Identity System
nodes.norm_label: game dev studio brand identity system

nodes.label: Brand Color Palette
nodes.rationale: Six-role palette: Background (#050510), Primary (#4FC3F7), Secondary (#7C4DFF), Panel (#0D1B2E), Border (#1A3050), Text Muted (#92A8C0). Follows 60-30-10 design principle.

nodes.label: 60-30-10 Color Ratio Principle
nodes.rationale: 60% background/panel neutrals, 30% primary/secondary brand accents, 10% highlights and decorations.

nodes.label: Safe Path Validation
nodes.rationale: Path traversal protection utility shared by creator/app/safe_path.py and drawio-service/app/safe_path.py; resolves user-supplied paths within trusted base directory to prevent directory traversal attacks.

nodes.label: DDL-First Schema Initialization
nodes.rationale: Database tables initialized directly by CREATE TABLE DDL in server/db.ts; when changing schema, update DDL first and use migrations only for legacy data backfill. This avoids migration overhead for fresh databases.

nodes.label: Pluggable Checker Architecture
nodes.rationale: Lint framework uses pluggable registration: implement LintChecker interface, register in builtInCheckers array. Both HTML and ZIP mode supported. Checkers receive submitDir via LintContext; SonarQube checker self-packs ZIP from directory for external scan.

nodes.label: Constrained Handoff Chain
nodes.rationale: Task handoff follows a role-constrained chain: game_designer -> ceo -> architect -> engineer -> biz_designer. Handoff targets are role-whitelisted.

nodes.label: Task State Transition
nodes.rationale: Tasks follow constrained state flow: todo -> developing -> testing -> done, with a blocked branch. update_task_status only accepts full UUID task_id.
